name: orbiters.myavatar
description: Apply texture sets to your avatar and optimize them in one click, put on clothes and accessories from their packages and fit them to your custom base (alpha), create its VRChat thumbnail, edit its VRChat menu as it will look in game, pose it with symmetry and a clothing preview, and set who can grab, pose and stretch its hair, tail and toes. Save also records a Unit Git checkpoint when Unit Git is installed.

com.vrcfury.vrcfury.reason: Accessories set up for VRCFury are installed with its Armature Link and merge their toggles and animations at build time.

nadena.dev.modular-avatar.reason: Accessories made for Modular Avatar keep their Merge Armature and menu setup when you add them to your avatar.

d4rkpl4y3r.d4rkavataroptimizer.reason: Merges meshes that use different materials at build time by rewriting their shaders, after My Avatar's own optimization.

orbiters.refit.reason: Fits clothing and accessories to your avatar's custom base and gives them its blendshapes, so they flex and move with your body.

vrchat.blackstartx.gesture-manager.reason: Tests gestures, the expression menu and animations of the avatar in Play Mode.

orbiters.unitgit.reason: Keeps checkpoints and the history of the project; Save also records one.

orbiters.mcb.reason: My Custom Base: shape the avatar's body and publish it as a custom base.

com.llealloo.audiolink.reason: Tests the avatar's audio-reactive materials in the editor.

adjerry91.vrcft.templates.reason: Animates the face's blendshapes from VRCFaceTracking: My Avatar sets it up in one click when the face has the blendshapes for it.

gogoloco.reason: Franada's locomotion system: sit, lie down and pose anywhere from the Action Menu. My Avatar adds it to the avatar in one click.

jp.lilxyzw.liltoon.reason: Free toon shader many avatars are made with. My Avatar suggests it when materials made for it don't render.

com.poiyomi.toon.reason: Free toon shader many avatars are made with. My Avatar suggests it when materials made for it don't render.
